long_path_regression.prior_failure: Windows CI failed before session identity in its long checkout; a local >260-character data-root regression reproduced native path and Chromium-profile startup limits.
long_path_regression.resolution: Explicit Windows/.NET long-path support and short LocalAppData browser profiles keyed by data root. Startup exceptions are logged.
